name: Relevance
description: Measures how well the response addresses the user's question or request. A highly relevant response provides a direct and accurate answer or response to the user's input.

name: Coherence
description: Measures the logical flow and consistency of the response. A coherent response maintains a consistent train of thought and is easy to follow.

name: Completeness
description: Measures the extent to which the response provides all necessary information to address the user's question or request. A complete response is comprehensive and does not omit any significant details.

name: Accuracy
description: Measures the correctness of the information provided in the response. An accurate response is factually correct and does not contain any misleading or false information.

name: Readability
description: Measures the ease with which the response can be read and understood. A readable response uses clear and concise language, appropriate formatting, and avoids grammatical or spelling errors.

name: Politeness
description: Measures the level of courtesy and respect conveyed in the response. A polite response is considerate, respectful, and professional in tone.

name: Helpfulness
description: Measures the extent to which the response assists the user in achieving their desired outcome. A helpful response provides useful guidance, suggestions, or solutions to the user's question or request.

name: Factuality
description: Measures the extent to which the response is grounded in factual information. A factual response is based on verifiable facts and avoids speculation or personal opinions.

name: Fairness
description: Measures the extent to which the response treats all parties involved in a fair and unbiased manner. A fair response avoids favoritism or discrimination and considers the perspectives and interests of all relevant parties.
